follow_ups.title: WebhookClient ReceivedMessages list shows full received token
follow_ups.reason: ReceivedMessages.razor binds WebHookReceived.Token, exposing the full token to anyone viewing the home page.

follow_ups.title: WebhookClient logs received and configured tokens in full
follow_ups.reason: WebhookEndpoints.cs logs both tokens at Information level, leaking the secret into logs.

follow_ups.title: Fix import ordering in src/Webhooks.API/GlobalUsings.cs
follow_ups.reason: On origin/main the file lists Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore before eShop.*, so dotnet format --verify-no-changes reports IMPORTS for any change that touches this file.

follow_ups.title: Add an e2e tsconfig.json with types: ["node"]
follow_ups.reason: The repo uses TypeScript 6, which loads no @types without a config, so the shared helper e2e/teststack/ports.ts (and any spec using Node APIs) shows 'Cannot find name process/child_process' language-server errors.
